channel.title: EvolutionNews.net — publications and updates
channel.description: New monitor publications and evidence dockets, substantive follow-ups, and corrections. Initial entries cover the federal monitor; older dockets are not backfilled.

item.title: September 19 federal monitor: power-plant rules, Chesapeake Bay and research funding
item.description: A new report distinguishes final and proposed power-plant actions, examines Chesapeake Bay and NSF policy, and follows all three earlier issues with NFID comments, a documented nuclear contractor separation and the water-rule comment deadline. Includes references and a downloadable bibliography.

item.title: September 19 update: vaccine consultation deadline and professional guidance
item.description: Follow-up to the September 6 report: the notice checked September 19 still specifies September 20 for assured consideration. The update adds pediatric participation guidance and expert commentary, distinguishes these from formal society submissions, and records limitations of the deadline check. Read the dated update for sources and participation details.

item.title: September 6 federal monitor: vaccine review, nuclear priorities and water protection
item.description: The original September 6 briefing reviews vaccine evidence standards, advanced nuclear delivery alongside renewable incentives, and proposed restrictions on federal water protection. Includes source references and a downloadable bibliography. Later developments are identified in dated updates.
